name: one-day infections create a moving wave
input: one infected cell followed by two healthy cells
test:
original = [[1, 0, 0]]
assert simulate_recovery(original, infectious_days=1) == (3, [[2, 2, 2]])
assert original == [[1, 0, 0]]

name: new infections receive the full timer
input: threshold two and a two-day immune barrier scenario
test:
assert simulate_recovery([[1, 0, 1]], infectious_days=1, infection_threshold=2) == (2, [[2, 2, 2]])
assert simulate_recovery([[1, 2, 0]], infectious_days=2) == (2, [[2, 2, 0]])
